newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $30.75 bln two-, five-yr notes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $30.75 bln two-, five-yr notes.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will sell $18.25 billion of two-year notes on Sept 25 and $12.5 billion of five-year notes on Sept 26 to refund $28.146 billion of securities maturing Sept 30 and to raise $2.6 billion of new cash.
The notes will be issued Sept 30. The two-year notes mature on Sept 30, 1998, and the five-year notes mature on Sept 30, 2001.
The CUSIP number for the two-year notes will be 912827Z47 and for the five-year notes will be 912827Z54.
